name: Media play control
author: dealenx (fork of Carmine Paolino's omarchy-mpris)
description: Media controls for the Omarchy bar with live album art, now-playing details, and previous/play-pause/next buttons for Spotify and other players.

barWidget.description: Album art, now-playing details, and previous/play-pause/next controls.

schema.label: Adapt to available space
schema.description: Shrink this widget before the bar's left, center, and right sections overlap.

schema.label: Album art only
schema.description: Show only the album artwork in the bar, without label or controls.

schema.label: Hide when nothing plays
schema.description: Hide the widget from the bar when no player has media.

schema.label: Maximum characters
schema.description: Maximum number of artist/title characters before an ellipsis is added.

schema.label: Maximum label width
schema.description: Maximum width of artist/title text in logical pixels.

schema.label: Show transport controls
schema.description: Show previous, play/pause, and next buttons when space allows.

schema.label: Show seek buttons
schema.description: Show back and forward 10 second buttons with the transport controls when space allows.

schema.label: Show album art
schema.description: Show album artwork beside the track label when space allows.

schema.label: Show artist
schema.description: Show artist before the track title when metadata provides it.
